scripts.build:rust: cargo build --release && { if [ "$(uname -s)" != Darwin ]; then exit 0; fi; helper=target/release/jeden-sandbox-helper; test -x "$helper" || { echo "sandbox helper is missing or not executable: $helper" >&2; exit 1; }; /usr/bin/codesign --force --sign "${JEDEN_CODESIGN_IDENTITY:--}" "$helper" && /usr/bin/codesign --verify --strict "$helper"; }
